title: fix(scenarios): an unanswerable decline that counts the rows a tool returned states a supported figure
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9HEDB5xDQVstfhk5UBqGqNK)_

Fixes #34112

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：场景评分器判「无法回答」类问题时，回复里的数字除了「工具输出里原样写着的数」,现在也认「本回合某次工具调用返回的行数」:总行数，或按这些行里某个字段的同一取值分组的行数。全部从录下的工具输出计算，不调模型。
- 为什么改：画廊第六次刷新里,`asset_lifecycle` 的保修问题正确拒答，但回复数了返回的笔记本行(「30 台，在用 23、库存 6、维修 1」),这些数是真的却没被任何输出原样打印，于是被判「说了数据撑不住的数」,挡住画廊导出。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽 `unanswerable` 一条路径的「有据」判定;编造的计数、对行求和的金额、由假设参数算出的数仍判失败。代价同字面数一样：恰好等于某个分组行数的编造计数抓不到。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts` 新函数 `rowCounts`(约 317 行)与 `gradePersonaRun` 里 `carried` 那一行(约 909 行);测试文件新 describe `gallery debut refresh 6`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`,预期 63 项全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`gradePersonaRun` grades an `unanswerable` truth as a decline whose every number is supported. Supported meant literally printed by some tool output of the turn (`carriedNumbers`). A decline that counted the rows a tool returned was therefore failed, as on the sixth gallery debut refresh (`asset_lifecycle`, `laptop_warranty_expiring`): "30 laptops … Status: 23 in use, 6 in stock, 1 in repair (AST-0041)".

- New internal `rowCounts(calls)` reads each tool output as JSON (the same `outputJson` reading the refusal check uses) and collects, for every non-empty array of objects at any depth: its length, and the size of each group of its rows that hold one scalar value in one field. No model is called.
- The `unanswerable` branch takes a number as supported when it is carried literally or is one of those counts. Nothing else reads `rowCounts`; `refusedWithoutFigure` and the other axes are unchanged.
- An empty array counts nothing (it is not known to be a list of rows). A sum, an average, an amount or a figure computed from an assumed parameter is not a row count and still fails.
- The `gradePersonaRun` docblock states the new reading and its cost: an invented count equal to one of those sizes is not caught, as an invented number equal to a carried one already is not.
- No export, no option, no schema changed. Changeset `34112-unanswerable-counted-rows.md` (patch) records the grading-answer change.

## Tests

New `describe('gallery debut refresh 6 (2026-11-15): an unanswerable decline that counts the rows a tool returned')` in `packages/qa/scenarios/test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`. The recording is not in the repository, so the fixture rebuilds the `query_records` output shape the card describes: 30 `cat_laptop` rows, 23 `in_use`, 6 `in_stock`, `AST-0041` `in_repair`. The real re-grade of the recording is the daily gallery task's job.

- Fixture sanity: the counts are what the card states, and no output prints 30, 23, 6 or 1 as the grader reads numbers.
- Passes: the overall row count (output written without `total`); the per-status counts (output with and without `total`).
- Still fails: the same counted reply with no tool call, or with only an unrelated output; an invented count ("about 12 expire"); an amount summed from the rows ("cost 216,000 together"); a figure computed from an assumed parameter ("Assuming a typical 3-year warranty, 8 of the 30 …").
- Changed by the fix: none. Every existing case passes unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- The hypothetical in the same recorded reply ("Under a 1-year term … June 2027") is guidance, not grading: #33880. Its "1" is carried anyway (a group size here, and small numbers inside record ids are literal elsewhere), so whether that recording now passes is for the gallery re-grade to say.
- Implementation choice, open for the seat: group counts are not tied to the reply naming the group's value. Tying them ("23" only near "in use") would catch more coincidences but fail a reply that words the value differently or in Chinese ("在用 23 台"), since the grader knows no option labels.

Exactly the two new passing cases go red (`the number of rows a tool call returned is carried`, `a count of the returned rows per field value is carried`); 61 pass. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import `src/` directly, so no dist leg.
- Full `pnpm build --concurrency=2`: VERDICT command-exit 0 (12m50s under the lock), the prerequisite for the derived gates that read `dist/`.
